summary: Per explicit human authorization, independently verified Phase 146D's CHGR-001 Sec.28 amendment (v1.1 to v1.2; CHGR-REQ-207 through CHGR-REQ-209) without trusting Phase 146D's own Sec.28.6 self-verification narrative. Independently reconstructed governing authority, schema, and validation semantics from primary sources: CHGR-001 Sec.11 (Authority Contract, CHGR-REQ-096/097), Sec.12 (Assurance Contract), Sec.26 (v1.1 revision), Sec.28 (v1.2 revision) read in full; PEC-001 Sec.20/PEC-REQ-111-117, PEC-REQ-115 quoted verbatim; IWPC-001 Sec.31 row C-1 quoted verbatim; the current human_governance_record.schema.json and envelope.schema.json (contract_version const composition); manifest.json; src/pcae/governance/publication/record.py read in full. Independently re-evaluated all five of Phase 146D's own root-cause candidates (A-E) against this directly-read evidence, not against 146D's characterization of it, plus one additional candidate (F) not named by 146D: a type:[string,null] widening with required retained -- independently rejected as fabrication-adjacent and strictly more complex than required-array removal for no compatibility benefit the removal does not already provide. Confirmed Candidate B (the frozen Phase 143E schema's required array, a sequencing artifact predating PEC-REQ-115 and CHGR-REQ-199/204) as the correct root cause. Independently reproduced the amended schema's satisfiability via live JSON Schema validation (Draft 2020-12, jsonschema+referencing, loading the actual on-disk schema files) against four constructed fixtures: omitted authority_basis_claimed valid; present-and-non-empty valid (backward compatible); a genuinely still-required field (decision_subject) missing still invalid; empty-string authority_basis_claimed still invalid (minLength:1 enforced when present). Independently recomputed the human_governance_record.schema.json SHA-256 file digest (1a59e2931c4e4b6c654f25823f0dc6d533e13bd015eb8bfe70e36bd878cdce58) -- matches manifest.json exactly. Independently confirmed via git show/git diff of commit 6794c0f5 that exactly two schema-family files (human_governance_record.schema.json, manifest.json) plus the contract document were touched, with zero production code (src/pcae/governance/publication/**, src/pcae/interactive_workflow/**) or test file changes. Ran the full existing CHGR test suite live: 127 passed, 2 failed, both independently root-caused to a pre-existing, environment-local limitation (python -m build unavailable, no network access) by reproducing the failure standalone outside pytest -- unrelated to this revision's content; confirmed no fixture under tests/fixtures/chgr/ asserted authority_basis_claimed's prior requiredness. Found two Non-Blocking, informational findings: (1) Candidate F was not in 146D's own five-candidate list and is independently recorded as evaluated-and-rejected for completeness of the candidate space; (2) CHGR-REQ-208's fail-closed disclosure-check has no implementation anywhere in the codebase yet, correctly, since this phase and 146D are both contract/schema-only. No Blocking findings. See docs/PHASE_146E_CHGR001_AUTHORITY_BASIS_AMENDMENT_INDEPENDENT_VERIFICATION.md. Verdict: VERIFIED.
